svg.title: Advanced S3 Helper Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of S3KtorClient advanced helpers for config objects, content-type detection, server-side encryption headers, presigned URLs, and client-side envelope encryption.
svg.text: S3KtorClient keeps advanced object workflows opt-in: helpers render request details, while apps own config parsing and key-provider policy.
KMS wrapper or in-memory test key
S3 object store: bytes, content type, metadata, SSE request headers
Reader contract: these helpers add S3 request structure; they do not parse app config, create mandatory AWS service clients, or persist plaintext data keys.
